overview: Medical, dental, and healthcare education in the United Kingdom is recognized globally, governed by the General Medical Council (GMC), General Dental Council (GDC), and Nursing & Midwifery Council (NMC), offering world-leading clinical rotations in NHS teaching hospitals.
eligibility: 10+2 with PCB (minimum 85%) + UCAT / BMAT entrance examination + IELTS (minimum 7.0 overall) + Multiple Mini Interviews (MMI).
